positioning.promise: Kungfu helps a fresh agent continue the same real-world work without asking you to explain it all again.
positioning.firstReleaseOutcome: Keep the work when the chat ends.
positioning.status: Kungfu 4.0.0-alpha.1 is the first public v4 Alpha, with desktop and standalone CLI artifacts; stable compatibility and independently published SDK layers remain separate release claims.
positioning.principle: One core, many complete products. Higher layers add convenience, never authority.
positioning.currentFocus: Accountable agent runtime is the current product focus; quantitative trading is historical proof and games or virtual worlds are a future derivative horizon.

brand.boundary: Kungfu is the product name. UNGFU is not a second product or runtime, and the trademark symbol makes no registration-status claim.
brand.trademarkNotice: Kungfu UNGFU™ is a trademark of Kungfu Origin Technology Limited.

firstScreen.coReadingPrompt: Share the machine entry with an Agent to inspect the same page map, claim boundaries, known limits, navigation, and source roots.

kfd3.parityRule: Human pages and the machine entry describe the same product mechanism, reading order, claim classes, known limits, navigation, and integrity roots.

adoptionLayers.label: .kungfu format and workspace contract
adoptionLayers.job: Inspect the pre-release portable authority, required-reader behavior, version matrix, schema registry, retained vectors, workspace layout and preservation rules.
adoptionLayers.notRequired: GUI, Electron, or a particular language host.

adoptionLayers.label: libkungfu
adoptionLayers.job: Embed the local truth-source loop, Episode lifecycle, query, verification, export and recovery.
adoptionLayers.notRequired: Python, Node, Rust host, Electron, cloud or database service.

adoptionLayers.label: Python, npm and Cargo SDKs
adoptionLayers.job: Use the same native semantics through one idiomatic language ecosystem.

adoptionLayers.label: Standalone CLI and TUI
adoptionLayers.job: Discover, record, query, verify, maintain and export headlessly.

adoptionLayers.label: GUI
adoptionLayers.job: Run complete supported visual workflows over public lower contracts.
adoptionLayers.notRequired: Knowledge of internal storage or SQL.

adoptionLayers.label: Assembled Kungfu App
adoptionLayers.job: Install compatible official layers as one convenience product.

surfaces.label: Product map
surfaces.headline: Keep durable work continuity while choosing only the Kungfu layer you need.
surfaces.summary: Start from the user outcome, then move through independently adoptable format, native, SDK, headless, visual and assembled products.
capabilities: Preserve current understanding, omissions, decisions and next action across fresh contexts.
Expose the same bounded product and evidence map to humans and agents.
knownLimits: The public product remains an Alpha prerelease; Stable and independently published SDK layers are not claimed available.

surfaces.label: .kungfu
surfaces.headline: An exact pre-release portable authority bundle, projected without creating a second format truth.
surfaces.summary: The site binds the exact installed @kungfu-tech/spec package coordinate, its normative root, v4 alpha baseline and artifact roots while the owning format, reader, migration, schema and vector contracts retain semantic authority.
capabilities: Inspect the portable authority overview and exact package pickup coordinate.
Route required-reader profiles, compatibility tuples, migration ownership and the schema registry.
Inspect the qualified retained cross-version vector corpus and every rooted artifact without monorepo reach-through.
Render all eleven integrity-bound human page models directly from the installed package.
knownLimits: The standalone portable format is pre-release and is not declared stable.
Package semver is a pickup coordinate, not a format compatibility algorithm.
The historical Spec 0.1 prose is non-normative.

readerExperience.headline: .kungfu is a portable, verifiable record of real work.
readerExperience.lead: It keeps one bounded piece of work—what happened, the facts and artifacts it produced, and the evidence needed to verify it—together so a fresh person or Agent can inspect and continue it without reconstructing the story from a chat.

humanSections.heading: Keep the work, not just the conversation.
humanSections.body: A folder keeps files. A transcript keeps words. Neither reliably tells the next Agent what actually happened, which information was trusted, which outputs belong to the work, or how to check them. .kungfu keeps those relationships together.

items.heading: What happened
items.body: An Episode records one bounded occurrence. Facts record the state the work relied on.

items.heading: What it produced
items.body: Artifacts, a Manifest, Receipts and dependencies keep outputs connected to the work that produced them.

items.heading: Why it can be checked
items.body: Content roots let another reader verify the retained material before trusting or acting on it.

humanSections.heading: How a fresh Agent continues the same work

items.heading: Work
items.body: An Agent performs a bounded piece of real work and produces facts, artifacts and evidence.

items.heading: Retain
items.body: .kungfu keeps the Episode and its verification material together instead of leaving context scattered across a chat and a folder.

items.heading: Continue
items.body: A fresh Agent can inspect what is known, preserve material it does not yet understand, and act only when the required semantics are compatible.

humanSections.heading: Not understanding something is different from losing it.

items.heading: Preserve
items.body: Keep unfamiliar but well-formed material as exact bytes without pretending to understand it.

items.heading: Inspect
items.body: Read structure and verification evidence within the reader's declared capability.

items.heading: Act
items.body: Deriving canonical state, admitting it as trusted, or executing it requires complete compatible semantics.

humanSections.heading: Qualified does not mean stable.
humanSections.body: This packaged format authority is qualified but still pre-release. It proves the current contract and retained test corpus; it does not promise stable compatibility or automatic understanding of every future format.

readerExperience.technicalSummary: Inspect the exact Spec contract, compatibility rules, roots and machine artifacts.

surfaces.label: Fact, Episode and Action Geometry
surfaces.headline: Two ontology bindings preserve reality; three action responsibilities keep intent, perspective and authority distinct.
surfaces.summary: Fact preserves admitted state at an explicit Cut. Episode preserves realized causal occurrence. Pursuit, Atlas and Warrant are Action Geometry responsibilities expressed over exact Facts.
capabilities: Fact: identify admitted state at a declared Cut.
Episode: retain what actually occurred with causal provenance.
Pursuit: preserve intended change and success conditions.
Atlas: preserve perspective, sources, omissions and Cut.
Warrant: preserve bounded authority for an exact action and state.
knownLimits: The runtime is a qualified shadow and does not claim authority cutover or P17 release qualification.
Episode is not a fourth Action Geometry primitive and occurrence does not prove completion.

surfaces.label: Runtime
surfaces.headline: Append once, observe live, and recover from the same retained evidence path.
surfaces.summary: The mmap journal, typed storage services, Fact and Episode operations, projections and explicit durability frontiers form the native runtime mechanism.
capabilities: Ordered append and zero-copy observation over the journal.
Fact admission, Episode lifecycle, historical query, verification, export and recovery.
Explicit visibility, commit and durability frontiers rather than one ambiguous success state.
knownLimits: Visibility is not durability; strong durability candidates are separately admitted and not the default universal claim.
Replication, high availability, arbitrary side-effect recovery and battle-tested external adoption are not claimed.

writer.label: Agent worker
writer.detail: Appends action, lifecycle and telemetry frames once.

journal.label: Append-only mmap Episode journal
journal.detail: One published frame stream is retained evidence and the local reader bus.

readers.label: Hub live tail
readers.detail: Observe published frames without a second event pipeline.

readers.label: Supervisor
readers.detail: Read heartbeat and progress without interrupting the worker.

readers.label: Rewind and replay
readers.detail: Reopen retained evidence at a qualified frontier.

readers.label: Local readers
readers.detail: Fan out one published stream to co-located consumers.

outcomes.title: Storage is the bus
outcomes.summary: The journal is not copied into a second transport just to become observable. Retained frames are the local read surface.

outcomes.title: Observation stays off the writer path
outcomes.summary: Readers attach to published mmap pages, so each observer does not require a new writer-side copy or broker hop.

outcomes.title: Recovery starts from retained truth
outcomes.summary: After failure, resume from the last qualified published or durable frontier and classify any unacknowledged tail explicitly.

semanticBoundary.heading: Frames record what happened. Policy decides what it means.
semanticBoundary.body: The journal carries ordered evidence. KFD and each Hub's local policy define authority, admission, completion and what may safely happen next.

frontiers.label: visible
frontiers.summary: A complete frame is published and available to declared live readers.

frontiers.label: durable_group
frontiers.summary: A frame is at or below a selected batch durable watermark. Production durable ingest remains disabled by default.

frontiers.label: durable_sync
frontiers.summary: Required data and metadata cross a named local durability barrier. Production durable ingest remains disabled by default.

frontiers.label: replicated
frontiers.summary: A separate replication policy acknowledges the frame; this is not a current implementation target.

qualificationClaims: The mmap MAP_SHARED publish barrier is implemented for a single writer and multiple cross-process readers.
The production mapping profile currently qualifies visibility; durable requests remain fail closed unless a named candidate path is selected.
The current reference Hub adapter carries lifecycle metadata, not prompt, tool, token, provider payloads or private journal bytes.
The wider visible typed-agent and multi-reader product surfaces remain separate end-to-end admission work.

surfaces.label: Native ABI
surfaces.headline: One public bootstrap discovers separately versioned responsibility interfaces.
surfaces.summary: KFD-7 standardizes kungfu_get_api with discovery, stream, ledger-action and maintenance v1 tables, stable numeric statuses and explicit protocol, schema and encoding fields.
capabilities: Negotiate ABI and interface versions without a language host.
Use owner-thread contexts, token-bounded results and explicit release.
Call stream, ledger-action and maintenance responsibilities behind one export.
knownLimits: JSON is the named v1 edge encoding, not Root identity.
Timeout is reserved in v1; cancellation is cooperative and does not preempt an admitted one-shot call.
libyijinjing has no shared ABI and Node is not a successor ABI reference wrapper.

surfaces.label: SDKs
surfaces.headline: C/C++, Python, Node and Rust remain thin surfaces over one native authority.
surfaces.summary: Each ecosystem package can qualify independently through clean install, capability discovery, the shared semantic fixture and the same .kungfu evidence path.
capabilities: C and C++ consume the installed Kungfu::kungfu coordinate.
Python and Rust start at kungfu_get_api and negotiate responsibility tables.
Node exposes the versioned storage contract over its current in-process native adapter.
knownLimits: Source and artifact gates do not themselves prove current public registry publication.
Stable compatibility and external adoption remain separate release claims.

surfaces.label: KFX and Domain Profiles
surfaces.headline: Extensions add views, adapters, services and domain meaning without minting Core authority.
surfaces.summary: KFX uses shared discovery and load planning across GUI and CLI hosts; Domain Profiles map adopter-specific objects and policy onto Fact, Episode and Action Geometry responsibilities.
capabilities: Discover view, adapter and service facets from explicit roots.
Plan trusted or confined execution before instantiating a guest.
Validate declarative Domain Profiles and preserve five inspectable responsibilities.
knownLimits: Native KFX registry mutation, attestation, admission and activation remain staged.
A valid Domain Profile declaration is not an installed or active signed Profile Suite.
Current language bindings do not claim equal Domain Profile lifecycle coverage.

surfaces.label: CLI, TUI, GUI and App
surfaces.headline: Headless and human products add complete workflows while lower layers retain semantic authority.
surfaces.summary: The CLI/TUI is the complete headless product, the GUI is the complete visual product, and the assembled App is the one-install convenience product.
capabilities: Operate semantic workflows headlessly without Electron.
Render complete visual workflows over public capability contracts.
Install compatible official layers together without collapsing their independent qualifications.
knownLimits: The public install path is Alpha-only; no Stable or native package-manager channel is claimed.
Published desktop artifacts do not prove production fitness, interactive pixel correctness, or a Stable compatibility line.

surfaces.label: Qualification and release
surfaces.headline: Design intent, implementation, qualification and publication are different claims.
surfaces.summary: Source acceptance and platform artifact gates bind exact evidence; public coordinates, signing and stable compatibility require their own release and publication proof.
capabilities: Qualify format, SDK, CLI/TUI, GUI and assembled product rows independently.
Bind exact source revisions, artifact digests, platform evidence and known limits.
Fail closed when evidence, budgets, publication coordinates or source cleanliness are missing.
knownLimits: A passing source-built gate is not a publication claim.
A Gate receipt never publishes, tags, signs or promotes an artifact.

surfaces.label: ADR map
surfaces.headline: Browse the complete decision corpus by domain, authority edge and bounded neighborhood.
surfaces.summary: The human mind map and machine projection are generated from ADR frontmatter and the audited corpus; inferred nearby links are navigation-only.
capabilities: Browse all ADRs across deterministic product and architecture domains.
Follow authoritative supersedes edges separately from inferred nearby links.
Inspect decision, implementation, review and qualification-reference status.
knownLimits: Domain membership and nearby links do not create architecture authority.
Xinfa remains the impact, dependency and stale-state authority.

surfaces.label: Domain horizons
surfaces.headline: One domain-neutral core, one current product focus, and bounded evidence or future horizons.
surfaces.summary: Quantitative trading supplies historical pressure evidence, accountable agent runtime is the current focus, and games or virtual worlds remain a future derivative design witness.
capabilities: Keep ordered facts, causality, Episodes, cuts, query and verification domain-neutral.
Add domain meaning through Profiles and adapters rather than forking the kernel.
knownLimits: The horizon map is not three simultaneous product roadmaps.
Games and virtual worlds are not an active product line without a bounded validation gate.

nonClaims: The standalone portable format is pre-release and is not declared stable.
Package semver is not a format compatibility algorithm.
The historical Spec 0.1 prose is non-normative.
Qualified-shadow Fact, Episode and Action Geometry work does not prove P17 release qualification or authority cutover.
Source-built SDK and product qualification does not prove current public package availability or stable compatibility.
Replication, high availability, arbitrary external-side-effect recovery and battle-tested external adoption are not claimed.
KFX discovery or a valid Domain Profile declaration is not installed, admitted or active extension authority.
The ADR map's inferred domain and nearby edges are navigation only.
Quantitative trading, accountable agent runtime and games are not three simultaneous active product roadmaps.
